snippet.title: Polaris (Atari 2600) - Longplay
snippet.description:
Polaris for the Atari 2600
Release date 1983

Mixed feelings about this game as it feels mostly underwhelming in every single aspect, but there are some moments like the submarines and airplanes in the first stage that make it somewhat fun.

What are your thoughts about this version of the game? Do you have any memories that you would like to share?
